EdTech companies sell learning outcomes and must prove them: engagement-to-evidence loops, content ops at scale, assessment integrity and institutional procurement gates. Product velocity matters, but evidence velocity closes renewals.

items: Engagement metrics ≠ learning proof; renewals wobble.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Process & Task Mining, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Learning analytics, Content operations, Assessment integrity) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — FERPA/COPPA/GDPR-K among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end: extraction, validation and downstream action.
See the work as it actually runs: event-log truth before you automate anything.
One automation spine: APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Education & Research level this capability reads as: early-warning signals trigger advising interventions with case management (retention lift in targeted cohorts). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The rhythm is fixed on purpose: progress becomes visible from week one, not after the first steering meeting. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
